category_specific_evidence: Regression test test_components_and_classes_cache asserts wcs.world_axis_object_components is wcs.world_axis_object_components (identity-based cache hit) when equinox is undefined (NaN).
The cache key tuple in _get_components_and_classes contained self.wcs.equinox directly; a NaN equinox compares unequal to itself, so the cache never hit.
Fix normalizes the equinox in the cache key: None if np.isnan(equinox) else equinox.
Changelog entry: Fix caching of wcs.world_axis_object_components and world_axis_object_classes in cases where the equinox was NaN.
